requests.scope: Explicit profiling rows including errors/partial records; ratios use scalar/histogram-valid core records, with separate full per-step-valid counts/sums. Missing lists are never synthesized. Planned trace lengths and A/B join require external workload mapping; no raw payload is read.

aiperf_engine_context.boundary_rule: last endpoint timestamp_ns <= start; first >= end; no per-series fallback
aiperf_engine_context.scope: Scrape interval context, including adjacent work; not exact profiling request cohort.

independent_telemetry.scope: Closed profiling interval by collection-loop start timestamp; actual sequential sample times occur later before next loop. Finite sample means, not instantaneous/time-weighted. Host lifetime counters remain sample context. GPU indices require external rank mapping. KV categorical series preserved verbatim; HBM bytes are distinct.

engine_context.boundary_rule: latest loop row with next-row timestamp <= profiling start; first loop row timestamp >= profiling end
engine_context.scope: Independent collector primary context; next-row timestamp bounds previous sequential scrape completion. All endpoint/rank series use these same loop boundaries. Adjacent work may be included.

aiperf_gpu_telemetry.units: Not embedded in these JSONL rows: preserve original metric field names and numbers; unit interpretation requires installed schema/aggregate metadata. nvidia_memory_used is not raw bytes.
aiperf_gpu_telemetry.scope: Separate AIPerf telemetry series; no merge with independent NVML samples or inferred GPU/rank mapping.

limits: No service or correctness verdict; no acceptance threshold.
First-chunk audit, runtime/source attestation, startup/capture evidence and A/B comparison remain separate.
CSV preserves actual request lengths; planned trace lengths require external trace mapping.
Counters are endpoint scrape intervals, not exact request cohorts; gaps/resets are never repaired.
No verifier kernel time or unconstrained model equivalence inferred.
